network.title: Title of the dialog for proxy and certificate settings.
network.webNoticeTitle: Title of the notice shown in the web app, where these settings do not exist.
network.proxyModes: Choices of how requests reach the internet.
network.bypass: Hosts that are reached without the proxy.
network.bypassPlaceholder: Example list of hosts; keep as written.
network.proxyAddressPlaceholder: Example proxy address; keep as written.
network.chooseCA: Tooltip of the button that opens the file picker. PEM and DER are file formats.
network.certificateHost: Label of the host a client certificate is offered to.
network.chooseCertificate: Title of the file picker. PEM, PFX and P12 are file formats.
network.chooseKey: Title of the file picker for the private key.
network.certificateFile: Lower case noun used inside Choose {{label}} and Clear {{label}}.
network.keyFile: Lower case noun used inside Choose {{label}} and Clear {{label}}.
network.chooseLabel: Accessible name of a file button; {{label}} is certificate file or key file.
network.clearLabel: Accessible name of a button that clears a chosen file.
network.noFile: Shown next to a file field when no file is chosen.
network.passphraseSaved: The passphrase is stored in the system keychain.
network.forgetPassphrase: Button that deletes the saved passphrase from the keychain.
network.certificatesNote: *.example.com is a pattern and stays as written. PEM, PFX and P12 are file formats.
network.collection: Heading of the settings read from gostman.yaml; the file name stays.
network.collectionActive: Explains how settings of the collection combine with the ones above.
network.collectionRestricted: Shown for a folder that is not trusted yet.
network.savePassphrase: Button that stores the passphrase in the keychain.
network.cancel: Button that closes the dialog without saving.
network.mode: Label of the choice between ways of using a proxy.
network.hostLabel: Label of the field for a host name.
